subject: design/e2e-verification-skills-v2
statement: e2e-review stands up as the **fourth instance of the reviewer program**, reusing `context-pack-v1`'s machinery via a stage declaration that maps the e2e design doc onto the admitted **frozen-subject** kind and the feature's PRD + live design set onto **governing-peer** kinds — all existing admitted kinds, no enum change — and reusing the sibling-session **blind fresh-context lens** runtime and scope-locked two-round convergence, emitting an `e2e-review-report/v2`.
